sonnet.problem: The blank asks the baker to guess a detail inside a line (wine, oil or rainwater). Nothing Papa Dorin has told them lets them reason it out. It works like the Psalm 23 'anoints his head with oil, myrrh or perfume' bad example, and the answer is not pre-supplied by earlier cards.
sonnet.rule: Never ask the baker to guess the next words of a line.

sonnet.problem: The blank asks the baker to guess which animal Jacob names (wolf, eagle or bear) from a line the baker has not seen. No earlier card gives context to reason it out, so the pick is luck.
sonnet.rule: Never ask the baker to guess the next words of a line.
